In Figure 1 (page 6), **GeM Pooling** produces the "Aggregated History Embedding" from the "Visited Profiles Embeddings." **Temporal-Gated Pooling** produces the "Aggregated User Embedding" from the user profile embedding and the aggregated history embedding.

**The diagram doesn't match the text.** The figure's labels differ from how the rest of the paper describes the method:

- **History aggregation:** The Figure 1 caption says the history tower "aggregates recent interaction embeddings using positional attention" (page 6). Section 4.3 also defines a position-aware attention mechanism (P-ATT) for history aggregation (page 5). The deployed model uses P-ATT history augmentation (page 8). GeM pooling appears in the text only as an alternative in the ablations, where it scored slightly lower than P-ATT (MAR@100 of 0.447 vs. 0.450, Tables 1 and 2, page 7).
- **User embedding:** The text describes combining the profile and history embeddings through "normalized additive fusion" with a learnable scalar γ (Equations 3–4, page 5). The caption also says "normalized additive fusion" (page 6). The document never explains "Temporal-Gated Pooling."

The diagram may show an earlier or alternative setup. The written method and deployed model use P-ATT and normalized additive fusion.
